issues.description: The problem statement's UML and task description indicate addGuestStudents(int) should have a void return type (UML: +addGuestStudents(int): void), but the solution implements addGuestStudents(int) returning boolean (public boolean addGuestStudents(int)). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and will cause incompatibility with tests or the specified design.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent. Either change the solution to implement public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (performing the addition without returning a value), or update the problem statement/UML to specify a boolean return type and document the meaning of the returned value. Prefer changing the solution to void to match the current UML and task description.
